content_sections.heading: VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 9 vacancies are available - 3 for Professor, 3 for Associate Professor, and 3 for Assistant Professor.

content_sections.heading: VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Professor: Master's Degree with minimum 60% marks in Information Technology, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management & Organisational Behaviour, General Management (PM & OR). Ph.D from a reputed Indian or International University/Institution. Minimum 10 years experience as Associate Professor. Minimum 8 research publications in peer-reviewed journals. Associate Professor: Master's Degree with minimum 60% marks in Information Technology, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management & Organisational Behaviour, General Management (PM & OR). Ph.D from a reputed Indian or International University/Institution. Minimum 6 years teaching experience as Assistant Professor/Deputy Director. Minimum 6 publications in Scopus/Web of Science/ABS/ABDC rank journals. Assistant Professor: Master's Degree with minimum 60% marks in Information Technology, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management & Organisational Behaviour, General Management (PM & OR). Ph.D from a top-rated University/Research Institution. Minimum 1-3 years teaching experience. Minimum 4 publications in Scopus/Web of Science/ABS/ABDC rank journals.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the VAMNICOM Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of VAMNICOM to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026 is 11 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the posts of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor in the VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across the different academic positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is a Master's Degree with at least 60% marks in the relevant field, along with a Ph.D. from a reputed institution. Specific experience and publication requirements vary by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for VAMNICOM posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 50 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, OBC, and PwBD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000 for General and OBC category candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Demo Class, Research Presentation, and a Personal Interview. Candidates will be evaluated on their teaching skills, research capabilities, and overall suitability.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Professor post is as per Level 13 of the Pay Matrix, which ranges from Rs. 1,23,100 to Rs. 2,15,900 per month, along with other allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification mentions that applications are invited from eligible candidates in Maharashtra. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification for any specific state-related requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. How should I apply for VAMNICOM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and upload necessary documents before the last date.
